name: Time to Explore - Sol
sourceNote: Planets: JPL approximate positions (Standish & Williams). Asteroids: JPL SBDB query, 100 largest main-belt objects. Moons: IAU/JPL physical data with authored epoch phases. Stations: fictional, positioned at real Lagrange points.

bodies.name: Sun
bodies.description: G2V star containing 99.86% of the system mass.

bodies.name: Mercury
bodies.description: Smallest planet; large iron core; 3:2 spin-orbit resonance.

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.description: Runaway-greenhouse world with a retrograde rotation.

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.description: Home world; the Earth-Moon barycentre is used for the heliocentric orbit.

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.description: Cold desert world with two small captured moons.

bodies.name: Jupiter
bodies.description: Largest planet; four Galilean moons; strong radiation belts.

bodies.name: Saturn
bodies.description: Ringed gas giant; Titan is the only moon with a dense atmosphere.

bodies.name: Uranus
bodies.description: Ice giant tipped on its side; its moon system shares the extreme tilt.

bodies.name: Neptune
bodies.description: Outermost giant planet; Triton orbits retrograde.

bodies.name: Moon
bodies.description: Tidally locked; the only other world walked on by humans.

bodies.name: Io
bodies.description: Volcanic moon heated by tidal flexing.

bodies.name: Europa
bodies.description: Ice shell over a probable subsurface ocean.

bodies.name: Ganymede
bodies.description: Largest moon in the solar system.

bodies.name: Mimas
bodies.description: Small icy moon with the Herschel crater.

bodies.name: Enceladus
bodies.description: South-polar plumes vent a subsurface ocean.

bodies.name: Tethys
bodies.description: Icy moon with the Odysseus impact basin.

bodies.name: Dione
bodies.description: Icy moon with bright tectonic fractures.

bodies.name: Titan
bodies.description: Thick nitrogen atmosphere and methane lakes.

bodies.name: Iapetus
bodies.description: Two-tone surface and a distant inclined orbit.

bodies.name: Miranda
bodies.description: Small moon with extreme fault scarps.

bodies.name: Ariel
bodies.description: Brightest and most fractured Uranian moon.

bodies.name: Triton
bodies.description: Retrograde captured moon with nitrogen geysers.

bodies.name: Proteus
bodies.description: Irregular, dark inner moon of Neptune.

bodies.name: Nereid
bodies.description: Highly eccentric outer moon of Neptune.

bodies.name: Gateway Station
bodies.description: Earth-Moon L1 transit hub and lunar-surface logistics depot.

bodies.name: Helios Watch
bodies.description: Solar observatory and space-weather warning station, 1.5 million km sunward of Earth.

bodies.name: Nyx Anchor
bodies.description: Deep-space telescope servicing yard and quiet-sector research station.

bodies.name: Ares Junction
bodies.description: Mars approach control, propellant cache and transfer rendezvous.

bodies.name: Jovian Transfer Yard
bodies.description: Large construction yard in Jupiter's leading Trojan swarm.

bodies.name: Titan Reach
bodies.description: Saturn-system depot at the Titan-Saturn L1 point.
